validation_attempts.title: Validation Attempts
validation_attempts.description: Total validation attempts across all items

validation_failures.title: Validation Failures
validation_failures.description: Number of items that failed validation

opus_cost.title: Opus Cost
opus_cost.description: Claude Opus API cost in USD

sonnet_cost.title: Sonnet Cost
sonnet_cost.description: Claude Sonnet API cost in USD

chatgpt_cost.title: Chatgpt Cost
chatgpt_cost.description: ChatGPT API cost in USD (GPT-4o for critics toggle)

dimension.title: Dimension
dimension.description: One of: correspondence, distinctiveness, clarity, specificity

reasoning.title: Reasoning
reasoning.description: Chain-of-thought explanation. Empty string for passing dimensions (score ≥ 7), detailed reasoning for failing dimensions (score < 7). Maximum 40 words when provided.

DimensionScore.title: DimensionScore
DimensionScore.description:
A single dimension score with chain-of-thought reasoning.

Represents one of four validation dimensions: correspondence, distinctiveness,
clarity, or specificity. Reasoning is only required for failing dimensions
(score < 7) to reduce token usage while maintaining quality feedback.

construct_name.title: Construct Name
construct_name.description: Construct name for this item (should match UserRequest.construct_name).

rationale.title: Rationale
rationale.description: Why this item reflects the construct. Maximum 50 words.

evidence_citations.title: Evidence Citations
evidence_citations.description: List of EvidenceChunk.source_id values that support this item.

validation_result.description: Optional validation result if item has been validated.

user_request.description: Original user request with construct definition, target population, and constraints. Enables export of context without separate API call.

linguistic_feedback.title: Linguistic Feedback
linguistic_feedback.description: All linguistic reviewer comments across iterations. Includes item_index, issue, severity, and suggested_edit.

bias_feedback.title: Bias Feedback
bias_feedback.description: All bias reviewer comments across iterations. Includes item_index, issue, severity, and suggested_edit.

content_feedback.title: Content Feedback
content_feedback.description: All content reviewer comments across iterations. Includes item_index, issue, severity, and suggested_edit.

FinalOutput.title: FinalOutput
FinalOutput.description:
Final items plus audit metadata.

Phase 03.1 enhancement: Added user_request and review feedback fields
to enable complete metadata export without breaking existing consumers.

item_index.title: Item Index
item_index.description: Index of the item in the batch

weighted_score.title: Weighted Score
weighted_score.description: Weighted average: correspondence*0.5 + distinctiveness*0.25 + clarity*0.15 + specificity*0.1

ItemValidation.title: ItemValidation
ItemValidation.description:
Validation result for a single item.

Contains four dimension scores (correspondence, distinctiveness, clarity, specificity),
a weighted score, and accept/reject decision.

item_index.title: Item Index
item_index.description: 0-based index of the item this comment refers to (when applicable).

issue.title: Issue
issue.description: What is wrong and why it matters. Maximum 30 words.

suggested_edit.title: Suggested Edit
suggested_edit.description: Proposed fix in plain text. Maximum 25 words.

ReviewComment.title: ReviewComment
ReviewComment.description: A single review comment produced by a specialist reviewer.

construct_definition.title: Construct Definition
construct_definition.description: Operational definition of the construct (in-scope and out-of-scope boundaries).

native_construct.title: Native Construct
native_construct.description: Optional native-language label for the construct (if relevant).

example_item.title: Example Item
example_item.description: Optional example item to emulate style/format. Do not copy verbatim.

item_count.title: Item Count
item_count.description: Number of items to generate. Minimum 2, maximum 50.

constraints.title: Constraints
constraints.description: Hard constraints for item writing (reading level, no idioms, etc.).

construct_exclusions.title: Construct Exclusions
construct_exclusions.description: Optional note describing what nearby constructs this is NOT and where overlap should be avoided.

human_feedback.title: Human Feedback
human_feedback.description: Optional human feedback to guide a refinement rerun.

previous_items.title: Previous Items
previous_items.description: Optional prior generated item texts used as refinement context.

approved_domains.title: Approved Domains
approved_domains.description: Optional domain allowlist to constrain web surfing retrieval.

exclude_sources.title: Exclude Sources
exclude_sources.description: Optional list of sources/terms to avoid in web search.

use_chatgpt_critics.title: Use Chatgpt Critics
use_chatgpt_critics.description: Use ChatGPT (o1-5.2-flex) for critic agents (validator, reviewers, critic). Item writer always uses Sonnet.

UserRequest.title: UserRequest
UserRequest.description:
The user's measurement intent.

Keep this contract stable. It is the single source of truth for downstream agents.
